## What changed

- Fixed: the Stop hook could block an agent again and again for the same code changes. The sync reminder is now shown once per set of code changes. Editing only `lat.md/` does not bring it back.
- Fixed: editing the sections the reminder listed did not clear it. A listed section now counts as reviewed when its lines change, and the reminder clears once every listed section is edited.
- The reminder no longer tells the agent to run `lat check`, which cannot clear it. It says what clears it, and that the agent may finish if no listed section needs a change.
- Fixed: committing doc edits separately from code made the hook say `lat.md/` was not updated. On a branch with an upstream, changes are now measured from where the branch splits from its upstream, so a commit does not change the result.
- The Stop hook now counts every error that `lat check` counts. Broken links, Mermaid errors, review status errors, frontmatter errors and a project with no `@lat:` ref now block a Stop too.
- The Antigravity and Gemini Stop hook no longer blocks when the project uses the commit-hooks experiment.
- You do not need to run `lat init` again. The installed hooks pick up these changes when the `lat` CLI is upgraded.
